thread:
Elena P: Quick capture from today's AH live Q&A. Putting the follow-ups here so owners can pick items. Keeping it short.

Raj K: Asked: will Dedicated GA include a short trial with burst credits and a simple SLA summary for sales?

Maya L: Yeswe'll provide a 14-day trial with a small burst pool and a one-paragraph SLA summary for sales collateral. I'll draft numbers and the contract snippet.

Chris T: Ops question from the thread: during canary do we allow cross-region fallback automatically? Need to know expected behavior so infra can implement the toggle.

Elena P: Behavior: prefer same-region compatible variant, then same-region alternative model, then cross-region cheapest compatible. Pause rollouts if active region incident.

Jordan R: I'll add that sequence to the runbook and include health-check thresholds + a manual rollback button in the console runbook.

Zoe H: Evals note: we'll snapshot 20 top customer prompts and run weekly regressions; alert if quality drops >5% on any critical prompt. Need product to share the top prompt list.

Nina S: SLA clarification: availability target is 99.9% monthly; P90 latency target 250ms for standard tier. I'll update the SLA doc.

Elena P: Owners captured (reply "taking" to claim):
- Maya L: billing/trial + contract snippet
- Chris T: infra toggle + canary PR
- Jordan R: runbook + health thresholds
- Zoe H: eval prompt set + alerts
- Nina S: SLA doc wording

Action checklist:
- [ ] Billing/trial blurb (Maya)
- [ ] Canary toggle PR (Chris)
- [ ] Runbook + rollback button (Jordan)
- [ ] Prompt snapshots + alerts (Zoe)
- [ ] SLA paragraph (Nina)

Example canary policy we discussed:
```
policy:
  priority: region
  fallback: variant -> model -> cross-region
  rollout: [10, 50, 100]
  rollback_on: latency>250ms || error_rate>1.5%
```

deploy-bot: canary deployed to staging (sha: ef34ab9) - smoke tests running.

Maya L: taking posting draft link in #docs shortly.

Chris T: taking PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/789. Toggle + rollback endpoint included.

Jordan R: taking runbook draft in review.

Zoe H: taking uploading prompt list to evals infra.

Nina S: taking SLA paragraph pushed to docs repo.

Elena P: Thanks everyone 44d. I'll compile the announcement once PRs + docs are in and loop in comms.
